Definition: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
BiblicalUsage: 1) goods, good things, goodness; 1a) good things; 1b) goods, property; 1c) fairness, beauty, joy, prosperity, goodness (abstract); 1d) goodness (of taste, discernment); 1e) goodness (of God) (abstract)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
